description: What workouts are on GetFit for legs / 20 minutes / dumbbells? Searches published workouts on Explore by body area, name, exercise and gear. If nothing fits, say so and offer build_workout to make one. Inputs: query, focus, max_minutes, equipment, discipline, source (people | agent | any), limit (default 5, max 20). Example: {"query":"legs","max_minutes":30,"equipment":"dumbbells"}.

equipment.description: What they have (preset, free text or list); results stay within it.

source.description: people = posted by GetFit members and trainers; agent = built on request

name: search_workouts
title: Search GetFit workouts
